page.layout: One column of running text, with a printed "JURIS ECCLESIASTICI." head and page number at the top. Small ditto marks (,,) stand in the left margin beside the lines. Below the text: a signature mark "I 2" and the catchword "& San-" at the right.

main_text.p: pag. 60. & 61. Robb. Cocum passim in cen-sura. Rivetum in Critico sacro. lib. 1. cap. 8. Withakerum de Pontifice Rom. controverf. 4. quæft. 5. Ioh. Gerhardum. tom. 1. conf. ca-tholi. lib. 1. part. 2. cap. 9. Caspar. Zieglerum, in diffært. de orig. & increm. jur. Can. quam præmisit Lancelotti Instit. jur. Can. §. 25. & seqq. Agmen claudat elogium, Cardinalis Iohan. Bonæ, quod de hac Collectione Pseudo-Isidoriana edidit nuper in liturgicis lib. 1. cap. 3. prin. Adstipulantur, inquit, Baronio Ioseph. Vicecomes, & Ioh. Baptista Scortia, in suis Tractatibus de sacrificio Missæ, & Stephanus Durantus, libro de ritibus Ecclesiæ, atque alii recentiores, qui ut probent Missæ nomen Apostolicæ ætatis esse, & Christianæ religioni coævum, ex Romanis Pontificibus primi & secundi seculi testimonia nullius roboris coacervant: dudum enim ab Eruditis observatum est illorum Epistolas decretales usque ad Siricium, suppositititias esse: à quodam Hispano sub nomine Isidori, quicunque ille fuerit sub finem septimi seculi (imo octavi vel initio noni, & forte non ab Hispano, sed Germano-Franco aut Franco-Gallo, ut supra latius dictum est) pia fraude (pace Card. Bonæ id liceat mutare in impiam impostluram) & ex sententiis veterum canonum, legum etiam civilium

page.notes: The ditto marks (,,) in the left margin are printed marks, not notes, and are not transcribed. The word "impostluram" is printed so in the source ("impostluram"); it is as printed. The text ends at "civilium"; "& San-" is the catchword at the foot.
